personal.risk: Unbounded capture may increase noise and perceived surveillance.

family.opportunity: Reduce spillover from fragmented business work and enable explicit handoffs.
family.risk: Family data must never enter organisational runtime without clear consent and separation.

business.opportunity: Convert conversational work into reusable institutional assets and executable queues.
business.risk: Source accumulation without execution telemetry creates zombie value.
